club.description: Humber Dock FC draws its identity from Hull's historic docks and the working waterfront of the Humber estuary. Maritime trade, dockside communities and the city's enduring connection to the water shape the club's character.

descriptions.de: Humber Dock FC bezieht seine Identität aus den historischen Docks von Hull und der Arbeitswelt am Humberästuar. Seehandel, Hafengemeinschaften und die dauerhafte Verbindung der Stadt zum Wasser prägen den Verein.
descriptions.es: Humber Dock FC toma su identidad de los muelles históricos de Hull y del frente portuario del estuario del Humber. El comercio marítimo, las comunidades portuarias y la relación duradera de la ciudad con el agua definen el carácter del club.
descriptions.fr: Humber Dock FC puise son identité dans les docks historiques de Hull et le front portuaire de l'estuaire de la Humber. Le commerce maritime, les communautés des quais et le lien durable de la ville avec l'eau façonnent le club.
descriptions.it: Humber Dock FC trae la propria identità dai moli storici di Hull e dal fronte portuale dell'estuario dell'Humber. Commercio marittimo, comunità portuali e legame duraturo della città con l'acqua ne definiscono il carattere.
descriptions.en: Humber Dock FC draws its identity from Hull's historic docks and the working waterfront of the Humber estuary. Maritime trade, dockside communities and the city's enduring connection to the water shape the club's character.
